reference_policy: No private text-task shape target; images compare public visible content; edits compare frozen before/target within permitted scope.
focus:
中央步道与小型纪念墓园；精确数值由程序测量；
Cemetery: twelve grave beds and markers in three rows/six per side of central path. Crypt at rear, front fence opening, round markers on one side and cross markers on the other. Thin iron fence on posts, crypt recessed doorway/roof, four crooked conifers and three light posts. Muted soil/pale stone/overcast calm; no people, text or horror effects required.

checks.question: Are the required grave:12 objects recognizable, complete and present in the required numbers? Names identify semantic instances, not Blender object names; allow equivalent modeling. Repeated objects are indexed in stable left-to-right order, or clockwise from +X for circular arrays. Evaluate visible semantics only, exact numerical geometry is handled automatically. Apply the case-specific identifying forms in focus; names and boxes alone are not proof.
